text.tspan: Answer: empty
markers carry no content

g.text: Fail — unknown inode, or a directory

text.tspan: 2 · decision only, no I/O
where do these bytes come from?
3a · FileIo read the scratch range
an open write buffer wins: edits in progress are
visible at once, and a deferred create is readable
before it has ever reached the server
3b · FileIo read the blob range
only while the cached ETag still matches
3c · Net range GET
online-only: serve just this range, live
the whole file follows in one streamed GET,
not a range request per chunk — measured against a
real server as 1 GET where it used to be 32

g.text: 404 — deleted on the server since we listed it

text.tspan: DbWrite remove_subtree
drop the node now, or a file manager sitting in
the directory keeps reading it and hammering 404s

g.text: Fail ESTALE — a stale handle, so the reader stops

text.tspan: planned: a pinned blob whose ETag no longer matches
is served anyway when the server cannot be reached,
and the user is told it is outdated.
Today the read falls through to the live path and
fails offline — the pin promise broken where it counts
4 · Answer: the bytes
the inode is idle again
a second read of the same range joins the running
transfer: one fetch, two answers
a flush arriving while reads are still outstanding on
this handle means the reader is gone — abandon them.
Measured: flush arrives immediately, release does not
